blocking: index.html journey: Mehndi (stop 7) comes after Aghd / Nikah (stop 6). In Persian, Afghan and South Asian families the henna night precedes the ceremony; a site that promises 'fluent in the unspoken details' cannot show the rituals out of order.

fixes.what: Swap the Mehndi stop before the Aghd / Nikah stop (order: Khastegari, Mehndi, Aghd / Nikah, Reception, Thank-you).
fixes.why: Hanabandan / mehndi / sangeet happen the night(s) before the aghd or nikah in every culture the site serves.

fixes.what: Change the note to 'The sofreh and the mirror, or the contract read before witnesses.'
fixes.why: 'The sofreh unveiled and the mirror moment' is Persian-only; Afghan and South Asian nikah families see their ceremony described as someone else's.

fixes.what: Move 'the baraat that arrives with music' out of the Mehndi & Sangeet section into Reception & Walima (or its own line on the wedding day).
fixes.why: The baraat is the groom's procession on the wedding day, not part of the henna or sangeet night; South Asian parents will spot the slip.

fixes.what: Label stop 3 'Our proposal' (keep پیشنهاد) so it does not read as a second 'proposal' next to Khastegari, 'The formal proposal visit'.
fixes.why: Two consecutive 'proposal' stops confuse the English reader; in Persian they are distinct words.

fixes.what: Reduce the desktop wordmark to width:min(80vw,920px) or push .hero__shade/.hero__window max-height to 60vh so the word sits across the foot of the arch, not over the table setting.
fixes.why: On desktop the wordmark hides the lower third of the footage; the footage is the only taste proof on the page.

fixes.what: Add a hidden, data-owner-input='proof' block like about.html's bio slot (one line: weddings run since YEAR, one family quote), to be unhidden when the owner supplies it.
fixes.why: The home page has no proof slot at all; parents deciding who to trust need one place where numbers and a family's words will land.
